description:
Job Details:
Title: Collision Repair Specialist
Location: Foster City, CA 94404
Duration: 6+ Months
Pay: $68 - $72 per hour
Schedule: Monday to Friday - 8am to 5pm (fully onsite)
 
 
Job Description
Note: Occasionally visit Hayward or Downtown SF to inspect vehicles, perform inspections, document damage, return to our home base
Company is seeking a Collision Repair Specialist to lead the execution of body repairs related to our test and operations fleet vehicles. As an expert, you will review collision damages and work with designated shops to develop repair plans and execute on them. You will support onboarding new shops at various operations locations to help build a Collision repair network. You will collaborate with the Fleet support technician team and program management to support repairs, testing and validation activities, spares forecasting to devise innovative solutions. You will define repair requirements by working with the Quality team to establish repair standards and practices. If you thrive on tackling ambiguous problems and have extensive experience in the collision industry, this role is perfect for you.
 
Responsibilities:
  • Support the collision program team in onboarding collision repair shops to develop a Company’s collision network at various operational sites.
  • Support the collision repair program in testing and validating repair solutions. Assist with the documentation of repair procedures and methods, thereby enabling SOP development.
  • Provide guidance to the repair shops performing repairs on fleet vehicles. Serve as a subject matter expert on all repairs by consulting with the engineering teams.
  • Partner with various cross-functional teams to support repair operations as needed, ensuring timely repairs and reducing vehicle downtime.
  • Collaborate with the supply chain team and serviceability engineers to develop a spare parts planning strategy for new vehicle releases.
  • Support cost estimation for repairs by collaborating with the repair shops and program team for use during collision evaluations.
  • Participate in repair activities to identify and document improvement opportunities. Collaborate with tooling engineers to create the necessary tools to advance internal repair capabilities.
  • Assist the program team with process development opportunities.
 
Requirements:
  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Automotive Technology.
  • Minimum of 4-6 years of experience in the collision industry with OEM Structural Repair Certifications from instructor-led training from Tesla, Jaguar, BMW, Mercedes Benz, Audi, etc.
  • Ability to explain and demonstrate best practices for all areas of collision repair methodology (cosmetic & structural) pertaining to Sheet Molded Compound, Aluminum, Steel, and Plastics.
  • Proven track record in performing complex body related repairs, collaborating with cross-functional teams to create solutions, and independently managing multiple projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform hands on paint related repair involving minor touch up
  • Proven capability in executing practical paint repairs, including minor touch-ups.
  • Strong computer skills, proficiency in Catia 3Dx CAD software or/and rapid assimilation of new systems are essential, or willingness and ability to quickly learn.
  • Willingness to travel domestically for business purposes as needed.
 
Bonus Qualifications:
  • Experience in developing OEM collision repair certification programs.
  • Familiarity with working on forged carbon/carbon fiber automotive bodies.
  • Experience collaborating with Vehicle and subsystem and Materials engineering teams to develop and drive testing for repair methods.
  • Experience developing OEM procedures, in addition to then performing, validating, and documenting those procedures.
  • CATIA experience is an advantage
  • Technical training experience

title: Phlebotomist II
description:
Job Description:
  • The Patient Services Representative II (PSR II) represents the face of our company to patients who come in, both as part of their health routine or for insights into life-defining health decisions.
  • The PSR II draws quality blood samples from patients and prepares those specimens for lab testing while following established practices and procedures.
  • The PSR II has direct contact with patients and creates an atmosphere of trust and confidence while explaining procedures to patients and drawing blood specimens in a skillful, safe and accurate manner.
  • The PSR II will demonstrate Leadership Behaviors while focusing on process excellence skills and sensitivity to confidentiality and accuracy to patient information. Successful applicants may be assigned to a doctor's office, a patient service center or as business needs dictate.

  • Must have reliable transportation, valid driver license, and clean driving record, if applicable.
  • Travel and flexible hours required to work multiple locations and required to cover at Patient Service Center/In-Office Phlebotomy locations with minimal notice.
  • Capable of handling multiple priorities in a high-volume setting.
  • Must demonstrate Superior Customer Focus; ability to communicate openly and transparently with peers, supervisors and patients; ability to accelerate and embrace change; and knowledge of our business.
  • Training locations may vary based on trainer availability.

Required Education:
  • High school diploma or equivalent REQUIRED.
  • Medical training: medical assistant or paramedic training preferred.

  • Minimum 2 years in a Patient Service Center environment preferred.

  • Keyboard/data entry experience.

title: Analytical Scientist
description:
POSITION SUMMARY
The Scientist will perform qualitative and quantitative chemical analyses/experiments for the Analytical Development laboratory for developmental products. Participate in method validation/transfer/verification and review method validation protocols, reports, and SOPs. Perform basic pre-formulation study for various dosage forms.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Track and review the project progress.
  • Identify and quantify all ingredients in a reference formulation to ensure cost effective formulation is achieved
  • Perform and evaluate study for pre- formulation of solids, solutions, suspensions, gels, ointments, creams, suppositories and sterile injectable dosage forms.
  • Transfer new analytical techniques from various clients.
  • Lead all routine analytical testing for In-process, release, stability and method validation/transfer/verification activity
  • Take a lead role for method development utilizing established scientific technique and automated instrumentation (UPLC, HPLC, GC, Dissolution, Auto titrate, Particle sizer etc.).
  • Lead out of specification investigation testing.
  • Write and review method development and investigation/deviation reports.
  • Ensure communications with all members of the team; respond professionally and in a timely fashion to internal and external customers
  • Thorough knowledge for various laboratory software usages
  • Other duties as assigned

POSITION QUALIFICATIONS
  • Analytical skills and knowledge of scientific protocols and complex scientific principles necessary to perform complex experiments and research on chemicals and medicines
  • Problem Solving - Ability to find a solution for or to deal proactively with work-related problems; ability to look beyond the standard solutions
  • Research Skills - In-depth knowledge and expertise in developing new analytical method.
  • Ability to design and conduct a systematic, objective, and critical investigation.
  • Good written and oral communication skills. Proficient in the ability to read/write and comprehend complex instructions, correspondence, and memos. Have the ability to effectively present information in a one-on-one or group situation.
  • Experience in method development, validation and transfer using chromatography (UPLC, HPLC, GC), Spectroscopy (IR & UV-Vis), Microscopy, and Wet Chemistry for sterile and non-sterile products.
  • Knowledge of ICH, FDA, and DEA regulations.
  • Advanced computer skills; ability to develop conclusions based on information from multiple sources.
  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs.
  • Ability to handle hazardous waste, and lead safety programs for the laboratory.
  • May be required to wear personal protective equipment

EDUCATION
  • A minimum of a BS in analytical or pharmaceutical related field
  • A Master's Degree in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Science or a related Science field preferred but no required

EXPERIENCE:
  • 5 Years working in Analytical Development in sterile pharmaceutical environment.
  • Experienced in the critical analysis of complex molecules and method development/method validation etc.
  • Solid understanding of cGMP, GLP and GDP.
